_comment: THE ONE ACRONYM LIST, read by THREE code paths so they can never drift (2026-09-06, after narrator's CAPS_ACRONYMS and Listen's LETTERED_ACRONYMS were found diverging the day they were both written). `lettered` = capitalised tokens read as LETTERS despite carrying a vowel (FBI, USA, DNA): narrator's caps fold keeps them as printed inside an all-caps run; Listen's acronym reading SPELLS them (F B I). `spokenAsWord` = tokens that must be KEPT AS PRINTED AND NEVER SPELLED (NASA, NATO, COVID, WWII) - see _spokenAsWordNote. A vowelless token needs no entry - both readers treat it as letters by rule. THE CAPS FOLD READS THE UNION, `lettered` + `spokenAsWord`, in BOTH readers: narrator's CAPS_ACRONYMS (paragraph_packer._load_caps_acronyms) and Listen's CAPS_ACRONYMS (electron/listen-text.ts). Listen's fold read `lettered` alone until 2026-09-13 and title-cased all fifteen spokenAsWord entries - 'Nasa' on Listen, 'NASA' in the m4b - which is the exact drift this file exists to prevent, so tools/test-one-fact-one-owner.js now computes both keep-sets from this JSON and asserts they are equal. Only the SPELLING consumer takes `lettered` alone. Extend when a text teaches us one: a miss reads 'Usa' as a word in a book, or spells 'N A S A' on Listen. Lives under python/narrator/text so narrator can load it standalone; electron imports it relatively (resolveJsonModule) and tsc emits it into dist.
_spokenAsWordNote: THE OPERATIONAL MEANING OF THIS KEY IS 'KEEP AS PRINTED, NEVER SPELL' - that is what all three readers do with it, and the name describes the reason rather than the behaviour. WWI and WWII were added 2026-09-13 and are the entries that make the gap visible: neither is pronounced as a word, but both must be kept as printed (narrator's vowel test sees the I and folded 'WWII' to 'Wwii' in a book) and neither may ever be spelled ('W W I I'). They sit here because 'lettered' is the key Listen SPELLS, which would be worse. If a third category is ever wanted - 'kept as printed, read as neither letters nor a word' - it is a rulable change, not one to invent in passing.
